title: Input Symbols Under Folding
statement: Let $\Gamma$ and $S$ be types, let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a word over $\Gamma$, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes and state set $S$ on input $x$. The possibly absent symbol scanned by the input head in the folded configuration of $c$ is the image, under the alphabet embedding, of the possibly absent symbol scanned in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: x is a list over Γ
c is a configuration with k work tapes and state set S on x
replaced:
For every configuration $c$ of a $k$-work-tape machine over a base alphabet
$\Gamma$ on an input $x$, the possibly absent input symbol scanned in the folded
configuration of $c$ equals the image under the alphabet embedding of the input
symbol scanned in $c$ (with absence mapped to absence).
